name: Quinine
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Quinine Sulfate (quinine sulfate), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — t1/2 ≈ 9.7-12.5 h in healthy subjects
halfLifeNotes: Healthy subjects after a single oral 600 mg dose (midpoint of 9.7-12.5 h used); prolonged in the elderly (~18-24 h), malaria, and hepatic/renal impairment.
